title: Power and Cables
subtitle: FE from fuel, stored and carried
text:
The Solid Fuel Generator burns fuel into 40 FE/t (60 on steel). The Battery stores 500k FE (1M on steel): it takes FE on every side but the front and gives it out of the front.

Redstone Copper Cable carries up to 1000 FE/t and connects to anything that takes or gives FE. Use a screwdriver on a cable side to disconnect it and again to reconnect it. Any of the 16 dyes colours a cable. The Charger, built from a Charger Assembly, fills FE items.
